nodes.summary: For every word-hyperbolic group $G$ that is not virtually cyclic, there is an integer $n \ge 1$ such that the subgroup $G^n$ generated by the $n$-th powers of the elements of $G$ has infinite index in $G$, i.e. the quotient $G / G^n$ is infinite.
nodes.title: Non-elementary hyperbolic groups have infinite power quotients

nodes.summary: For every word-hyperbolic group $G$ that is not virtually cyclic (non-elementary), there is an integer $n \ge 1$ such that the subgroup $G^n$ generated by the $n$-th powers of the elements of $G$ has infinite index in $G$, i.e. the quotient $G / G^n$ is infinite.
nodes.title: Kourovka Problem 11.74(a) (infinite power quotients of hyperbolic groups)

nodes.summary: For a group $G$ and a natural number $n$, $G^n$ is the subgroup of $G$ generated by the $n$-th powers $g^n$ of all elements $g \in G$.
nodes.title: Power subgroup

nodes.summary: For every word-hyperbolic group $G$ that is not virtually cyclic, the only element of $G$ lying in the subgroup $G^n$ generated by the $n$-th powers for every integer $n \ge 1$ is the identity, i.e. $\bigcap_{n \ge 1} G^n = 1$.
nodes.title: Power subgroups of a non-elementary hyperbolic group intersect trivially

nodes.summary: For every word-hyperbolic group $G$ that is not virtually cyclic (non-elementary), the only element of $G$ lying in the subgroup $G^n$ generated by the $n$-th powers for every integer $n \ge 1$ is the identity, i.e. $\bigcap_{n \ge 1} G^n = 1$.
nodes.title: Kourovka Problem 11.74(b) (trivial intersection of power subgroups)

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
